title: Figures 4.5-4.6: IEC Double Well Depth and Velocity Components at Cathode Grid
description: Figure 4.5 plots potential (keV, -25 to 0) versus radius (m, 0 to 0.075) illustrating the double-well depth, with labels 'Virtual cathode', 'Virtual anode' and 'Real cathode'; the caption defines 'Double Well Depth [%] = -dV/Vtot x 100' for a 30-keV injection case. Figure 4.6 is a schematic of a dashed circular 'IEC cathode grid' around the 'IEC center' with velocity vector v resolved into parallel and perpendicular components, captioned 'The Definition of the Parallel and Perpendicular Velocities at the IEC Cathode Grid'.
